title: Switching a long recording to Edit never freezes the app, and its tool bar arrives with the slide
goal: Switching a long captioned recording from View to Edit slides smoothly, but the tool bar and the track rows fill in up to about 0.7s after the key, and now and then the app freezes for longer than 100 ms in that time (118.6 ms in the 2026-10-20 full sweep), which fails its walk. The panel may arrive just after the slide (settled on 2026-10-20, when the waiting cards were taken as recommended); the tool bar and track rows should arrive with it, and nothing should hold the app for 100 ms.
notes: Follows the-slide-into-edit-mode-draws-every-frame-like, which moved every stage after the key pass to wait for the slide (EditModeArrival.nextWaitsForTheSlide). Profiled 2026-09-30 with xctrace Time Profiler against the probe, samples cut to the 500ms after each Cmd-2: about 480ms busy per switch either way; about 270ms of it is per-frame NSHostingView.layout while canvas/panel/dock frames animate. Into Edit, SwiftUI AccessibilityNode.updateFocusResponder was about 28ms per switch (walks the whole responder tree after every render, grows with every view built), AccessibilityViewGraph.update about 10ms more. Per frame the canvas updateNSView runs CanvasNSView.apply → refreshOverlaysInsideTransaction, refreshLayerSelectionDisplay, canvasNameLabels because canvasViewSizeChanged writes a new viewport each frame. Stage costs: key pass ~50ms, timeline+tool bar ~80, track rows ~90 (captions lane with 191 cues and words lane), panel sections 15 to 45ms each (CaptionStylePreview, PanelFieldRowLayout, SystemSegments.sizeThatFits). Measure with a filmWindow step (docs/design/playtest-harness.md) rather than mainBusy alone.
acceptance: On the five minute captioned sample, the tool bar and track rows are drawn within 350ms of Command 2, and the panel's sections follow just after the slide, never part way through it

view-to-edit-on-a-long-recording-walk passes three runs in a row: the filmed slide never sits still for 30ms in its first 330ms, and no main-thread pass reaches 100 ms (it failed at 118.6 ms in the 2026-10-20 sweep and about 135 ms on 2026-10-06)
The main thread is busy for well under half of the 0.8s after Command 2 (about 630 to 680ms on 2026-09-30)

log.note: Reproduced 2026-10-02 (screen locked, forced walk): View to Edit on the 5 min captioned sample, slide lands ~280ms, ruler ~360ms, tool bar and rows ~400-435ms, panel sections until ~800ms; main thread 615ms of 0.8s. xctrace: almost all of it is SwiftUI/AppKit layout and commit, app code tiny.

Adversarial review: no build cost can fit in the 60ms between the slide landing (~290ms) and 350ms, and building during the slide stutters it (2026-09-30), so the pieces have to exist before Cmd-2. Built Edit's pieces behind View, out of sight, after 0.6s idle, paused while playing, kept for the window's life. Risks checked: View playback cost (hidden tracks sleep while hidden: +8% main thread, was +25%), walks finding hidden controls (out of reach once the slide lands), accessibility (hidden after the slide), Cmd-1 latency (same as baseline, 46-88ms first picture).

Finding: a full panel sliding in halves the slide's pictures (16-18 in 330ms, 26-40ms stills) however it moves: offset, width, mask, fixed height, own hosting view, under the canvas, compositingGroup, geometryGroup, opacity 0, no dropdowns, still reels all measured, none helped; only fewer mounted sections did (Captions section is the heavy one). So the panel is behind View only with next-panel-with-the-slide (off); by default it fills a section a pass after the slide (Time ~0.30s, Captions ~0.38s).

Acceptance: (1) tool bar and track rows drawn within the slide (~0.3s) MET; panel sections by ~0.38s NOT MET by default (met with the switch, at the cost of (2)). (2) filmed slide longest still 18-20ms in 4 runs MET (walk claims it; baseline measured 37-45ms the same day). (3) main thread 550-600ms of 0.8s NOT MET (baseline 533-639): it is the window drawing the slide at full rate, the slide back to View costs the same; not reachable without making SwiftUI frames cheaper. Suite 10911 green; 17 related walks green (13 forced under a lock; an-editing-session and video-tool-bar fail identically on the old code under a lock). Commit 4bce21d4. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-02-edit-arrives-with-the-slide.json.

Left rough (no task, under the bar): canvas content layer re-set every frame looked like an 18ms colour conversion in the profile but guarding it changed nothing, so it was reverted; the walk's offscreen snapshot right after a switch can take 12-29s (pre-existing, walk overhead only).

Tool bar and tracks now come in with the slide (built behind View), slide smooth (18-20ms stills); panel fills ~0.08s after landing by default. Waiting on the decision whether the panel should come in with the slide at a less smooth slide (switch next-panel-with-the-slide lets the user try it). Main-thread criterion not met: it is the slide's own drawing. Commit 4bce21d4, audit 2026-10-02-edit-arrives-with-the-slide.
